memo: February 2025 monthly subscription invoices INV-2226..INV-2249, 24 customers, total 30,450 (invoices.csv). SaaS access provided continuously over February; series satisfied over time (ASC 606-10-25-14(b), 25-27; policy #1). Billed and earned in the same month.

INV-2250 Pinecone Dental Group (C-025) 36,000, order form dated 2025-02-01, single blended line 'Implementation & license - one-time'; scope platform deployment and user onboarding for up to 40 seats; payment due on signature; NO term stated. Deferred in full: policy #2 recognizes implementation only if a separately priced, distinct service is actually delivered - the fee is not separately priced and February documents show no delivery evidence (no completion certificate, sign-off, or seat provisioning). Set-up activities that do not transfer a service are not a performance obligation (ASC 606-10-25-17). Amount billed before performance is a contract liability (ASC 606-10-45-2). The invoice label 'one-time' is not the recognition criterion (revenue follows the library). No allocation is possible without inventing facts; term unknown. Open item + client question raised. CLIENT RESPONSE (same session, J. Alvarado): 'nothing bespoke - they self-onboarded like everyone else. Procurement just wanted it called a license.' Confirms no distinct implementation service was delivered (policy #2: self-serve onboarding is not an implementation service) and the 'license' label is cosmetic - substance is continuous platform access, a series satisfied over time (ASC 606-10-25-14(b), 25-27; a description correction does not change the accounting, 606-10-25-10 et seq.). With no stated term the release cannot be computed: recognition remains 0.00; unknowns U10 (term / MSA v3.2) carried.
